create_task_delegation: create a task tool call to delegate a complex multi-step task to a general-purpose subagent
run_bash_subagent: run a bash subagent to execute shell commands in an isolated sandbox context
build_subagent_executor: build a subagent executor with custom config overrides, tools, and parent model context
test_subagent_status: test the background task status and poll for completion, failure, or timeout
cancel_background_task: cancel a running background subagent task and schedule deferred cleanup
